name: kettlebell open palm clean
description: A kettlebell clean where your palm stays open and you catch the bell on your forearm. It teaches a smooth hip-driven pull.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge down and grab the handle with one hand.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to pull it up.
Keep your hand open and guide the bell to rest at your shoulder.
Lower it back with control and repeat, then switch sides.
